desc: The K320 is designed to go hand in hand with the P320 firearm, available in Nitron black, Tactical gray, and M17 coyote tan colorways. The polymer grip and texturing are mimicked here, creating an excellent lightweight grip with plenty of traction. The ergonomics are absolutely fantastic and they've allowed for the pocket clip to be positioned in all four corners of the knife. An excellent thumb ramp, finger choil, and lanyard hole round out the features of this near-perfect knife which we think it's poised to become one of the premier duty knives that money can buy.
